results.title: What is Data Annotation: A Basic to Advanced Guide for 2026 - Shaip
results.content: Data annotation refers to the process of labeling data (text, images, audio, video, or 3D point cloud data) so that machine learning algorithms can process and understand it. Video annotation is the process of labeling and tagging objects, events, or actions across frames in a video so that AI and computer vision models can detect, track, and understand them over time. LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) annotation is the process of labeling 3D point cloud data collected by LiDAR sensors so AI models can detect, classify, and track objects in a three-dimensional environment. LLM (Large Language Model) annotation is the process of labeling, curating, and structuring text data so that large-scale AI language models (like GPT, Claude, or Gemini) can be trained, fine-tuned, and evaluated effectively. A data annotation/labeling tool is a cloud-based or on-premise platform used to annotate high-quality training data for machine learning models. * Data annotation is the process of labeling data to train machine learning models effectively.
